title: Haseltine's novel Out of Time hiding truths

tellings.quote: former director of NSA research, Eric Haseltine, who I had on my show. He wrote a a {quote} {unquote} fiction book. I think it was called Out of Time.

plain: Michels suggests that a novel by Eric Haseltine, a former director of research at the National Security Agency who has been a guest on his show, may hold real truths dressed up as fiction. He calls it a fiction book with audible air quotes and says he thinks it was called Out of Time. Michels says this himself, without saying what the book reveals. If he is right, a former intelligence insider would be using a novel to say what he could not say openly.
